subject: cfa: no intercept estimates when missing is set to "listwise"

messages.author: 3bcf153c8ffd6d9e
messages.subject: cfa: no intercept estimates when missing is set to "listwise"
parts:
When I do a cfa using lavaan I don't get intercept estimates when I set missing to listwise. However, when I choose fiml for missing I do get intercept estimates. I don't get why there are there no intercept estimates when missing = 'listwise'. Any help would be much appreciated.

Some example code:
data <- lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939

model <- "
    visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
    textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
    speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9

    x1 ~~ x2
"
fit1 <- lavaan::cfa(model = model, data=data, std.lv=TRUE, missing="listwise")
fit2 <- lavaan::cfa(model = model, data=data, std.lv=TRUE, missing="fiml")

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: cfa: no intercept estimates when missing is set to "listwise"
parts:
Ravi,
FIML estimation requires mean structures.  See fit3 below.

require(lavaan)

data <- lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939

model <- "
    visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
    textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
    speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9

    x1 ~~ x2
"
fit1 <- lavaan::cfa(model = model, data=data, std.lv=TRUE, missing="listwise")
fit2 <- lavaan::cfa(model = model, data=data, std.lv=TRUE, missing="fiml")

summary(fit1)
summary(fit2)

fit3 <- lavaan::cfa(model = model, data=data, std.lv=TRUE, missing="listwise", meanstructure=TRUE)
summary(fit3)

Keith
